title: The Tiny Cloud Bird That Becomes a Dragon
premise: Swablu looks like a tiny cloud-winged bird, obsessively keeps clean, then evolves into Dragon/Flying Altaria.
audiencePromise: Start with Swablu's cloud-like wings and strange cleaning habit, then reveal the Dragon evolution hiding at level 35.
openLoop: How does this tiny cotton-winged bird end up becoming a Dragon type?
payoff: At level 35, Swablu evolves into Altaria and changes from Normal/Flying to Dragon/Flying.
engagementQuestion: Which design wins: tiny cloud bird Swablu or cloud dragon Altaria?

voice.instructions: Warm, playful Pokémon short narrator. Start with cute curiosity, make the cleaning behavior feel charming and weird, then land the Dragon-type evolution as the surprise. Keep it crisp, conversational, and natural. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: THIS CLOUD BIRD BECOMES A DRAGON
scenes.narration: This tiny cloud bird eventually evolves into a dragon.
scenes.caption: CLOUD BIRD → DRAGON

scenes.headline: THEY'RE BASICALLY CLEANING CLOTHS
scenes.narration: Those fluffy wings are cleaning cloths. Swablu wipes dirt away with them.
scenes.caption: SOFT WINGS. VERY SERIOUS CLEANING.

scenes.headline: DIRTY WINGS? SHOWER TIME.
scenes.narration: If they get dirty, Swablu showers until its wings are clean again.
scenes.caption: DIRTY → SHOWER → CLEAN

scenes.headline: THE WHOLE DESIGN FLIPS
scenes.narration: Then level thirty-five flips the whole design: Normal typing becomes Dragon.
scenes.caption: NORMAL → DRAGON

scenes.headline: MEET ALTARIA
scenes.narration: Altaria is Dragon and Flying, wrapped in even bigger cloud wings.
scenes.caption: CLOUD BIRD → CLOUD DRAGON

scenes.headline: WHICH DESIGN WINS?
scenes.narration: Better design: tiny cloud bird, or cloud dragon?
scenes.caption: SWABLU VS ALTARIA
